verdict.rationale: There is no evidence of a native, built-in AI assistant in Obsidian; the only AI-related mention is a third-party community plugin ('Copilot for local AI via Ollama') added by users, not a first-party feature with data-scoping controls. One community comment even questions whether local RAG-on-notes tooling works well at all, reinforcing the absence of a shipped built-in assistant.
